load_xlmr_pretrained_model: load a pretrained XLMR model using XLMRModel.from_pretrained with model name like xlmr.base
list_xlmr_hub_models: list available XLMR hub models and their download URLs via XLMRModel.hub_models class method
extract_features_from_tokens: extract feature vectors from tokenized input using the RobertaHubInterface extract_features method
register_classification_head: register a new classification head on the XLMR model with a custom name and number of classes
predict_with_classification_head: run prediction using a registered classification head on tokenized input via the predict method
